summary.en: An infinite series is the limit of its partial sums; it converges only when those sums settle on a value, and terms shrinking to zero is necessary for that but nowhere near sufficient.
summary.et: Lõpmatu rida on selle osasummade piirväärtus; rida koondub ainult siis, kui need summad settivad mingile väärtusele, ning liikmete kahanemine nullini on selleks vajalik, kuid kaugeltki mitte piisav.
